examples.japanese: {姪|めい}は{今年|ことし}{小学校|しょうがっこう}に{入学|にゅうがく}する。
examples.english: My niece is starting elementary school this year.

examples.japanese: {姪|めい}っ{子|こ}が{遊|あそ}びに{来|き}た。
{姪|めい}の{誕生日|たんじょうび}プレゼントを{買|か}った。
examples.english: I bought a birthday present for my niece.

notes:
{姪|めい} refers to one's niece (sibling's daughter).

FAMILY TERMINOLOGY:
- {姪|めい} (niece)
- {甥|おい} (nephew)
- {姪|めい}っ{子|こ} (niece - more casual/affectionate)
- {甥|おい}っ{子|こ} (nephew - more casual/affectionate)

POLITE FORMS (for others' relatives):
- お{姪|めい}さん (your niece - polite)
- お{甥|おい}さん (your nephew - polite)
